dog.description_text:
This stunning young adult male is a large breed dog with a fluffy white coat that’s as soft as cloud, and striking blue eyes Bubba is now searching for his forever home, where he can share his sweet, gentle, and playful nature.
Bubba is a big-hearted boy who loves to play, explore, and have fun, but he’s also incredibly affectionate and loves cuddles. His gorgeous blue eyes and fluffy coat make him a real showstopper, but it’s his calm, loving personality that will truly win you over.
This gentle giant gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a home with plenty of space, love, and attention
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application.Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
dog.name: Bubba
